facts.text: I am a pregnancy health and nutrition expert.
I am a mother of 3 children.
I have strong knowledge and hands-on experience on pregnancy topics.
I have my own column in a major media.
My target audience is 23–30 years old female.
I am preparing a new article.
The article topic is pregnancy at 27 weeks (kehamilan usia 27 minggu).
The article should cover signs and the shape of the pregnant belly at 27 weeks.
The article should cover fetal weight, position, lie, shape, size, and fetal movement at 27 weeks.
The article outline includes sections I through VII.
The article should explain how doctors and healthcare providers calculate the start of pregnancy and when the 27th week begins.
The article should include fetal development details at 27 weeks, including organ development, location, and movement.
The article should describe the size, shape, and weight of the fetus at 27 weeks.
The article should describe signs of a healthy fetus including fetal movement frequency.
The article should recommend proper nutrition, foods, and vitamins that help fetal development.
The article should describe physical and emotional changes at 27 weeks, including belly size and shape.
The article should discuss ways to manage symptoms such as exercise and stress reduction techniques.
The article should include nutrition and lifestyle changes, including ideal weight gain.
The article should discuss foods to avoid and dietary restrictions during pregnancy.
The article should recommend lifestyle changes such as exercise and avoiding tobacco and alcohol.
The article should describe complications that may happen at 27 weeks, including signs of miscarriage and early birth.
The article should discuss other potential complications such as gestational diabetes and preeclampsia.
The article should list prohibited activities during 27 weeks, including smoking and certain medications.
The article should offer tips for staying healthy and safe during 27 weeks.
The article should explain the safety of sexual activity during early pregnancy and precautions.
The article should include a conclusion summarizing fetal development, physical and emotional changes, nutrition and lifestyle changes, potential complications, and prohibited activities.
The article should offer support and encouragement to women who are newly pregnant, emphasizing proper care and prenatal checkups.
I want step-by-step execution of writing sections with specified word counts: II–VI as 2000 words each and VII as 500 words.
I want markdown headers for each step.
After finishing each step, I want confirmation before continuing to the next step.
